# SELECTOR TYPES
++list  
# BASIC SELECTORS  
- `element` — selects all elements of that type  
- `.class` — selects elements by class  
- `#id` — selects elements by ID  
- `*` — universal selector  
- `[attr]`, `[att="val"]`, `[att~="val"]`, `[att|="val"]`, `[att^="val"]`, `[att$="val"]`, `[att*="val"]` — attribute selectors  
--list
++list  
# COMBINATORS  
- `E F` — descendant  
- `E > F` — child  
- `E + F` — adjacent sibling  
- `E ~ F` — general sibling  
--list
++list  
# PSEUDO-CLASSES & PSEUDO-ELEMENTS  
- Pseudo-classes: `:active`, `:focus`, `:hover`, `:visited`, `:link`, `:disabled`, `:enabled`, `:checked`, `:selection`, `:lang(...)`, `:nth-child(n)`, `:first-child`, `:last-child`, `:only-child`, `:empty`, `:root`, `:not(x)`, `:target`  
- Pseudo-elements: `::first-letter`, `::first-line`, `::before`, `::after`  
--list
# BOX MODEL
++p  
Every element comprises content, padding, border, and margin. `box-sizing` (`content-box` or `border-box`) affects width/height calculations.  
--p
++list  
# PROPERTIES  
- `width`, `height`, `min-/max-width`, `min-/max-height`  
- `padding-*`, `margin-*`  
- `border`, `border-width/style/color`, `border-radius`, `box-shadow`  
--list

# BACKGROUND  
- `background-color`, `background-image`, `background-position`, `background-size`, `background-repeat`, `background-attachment`, `background-origin`, `background-clip`, `background-break`  
--list

##### About Arthor parents

#### Introduction
- Arthor parents were scientists who ran away from the government hiding some essential facts and papers. It happened one year before the birth of Arthor. 
#### Cause of accident
- They plotted the cause of accident to be a car accident falling out from the bridge into the river with the help of some friend, who also helped them escape. The body was never found but was assumed to have eaten by aquatic life, although some documents were left to be discovered in the hope to make the accident eventful. 
#### now
- They were able to find a village named La Malbaie far away from the town inside the continent, where they are living with their fake names. Mean while,  Sereia became pregnant with Arthor in her womb. Elion started his hardware shop with the help of little money he has reserved. There they began a new life.
